channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Young women’s complaints prompt Michigan State U. to restore single-sex dorm showers
item.description: After female residents at Michigan State University expressed discomfort with new "gender neutral" bathrooms, including shower areas, the university restored some to single-sex spaces.

item.title: UC Berkeley, Pomona College reach deals with Jewish groups over antisemitism claims
item.description: Two California universities reached settlements with Jewish advocacy groups over antisemitism allegations this month. The University of California Berkeley will pay $60,000 to Israeli sociologist and dance researcher Yael Nativ, according to a news release from the Louis D. Brandeis Center, which filed the lawsuit. Berkeley will also reinstate Nativ (pictured) as a visiting dance […]

item.title: TRENDING: SUNY Plattsburgh approves furry club, joining campuses across nation
item.description: Not 'all about sex': Some experts, students defend college furry clubs' creative core.

item.title: Brown U. shooter remains at large as authorities release new videos, offer $50K reward
item.description: Video evidence has been coming in at a much greater degree, official says.

item.title: Alabama DEI ban is classroom ‘censorship,’ professors allege in federal appeal
item.description: A group of University of Alabama students and professors just appealed a federal ruling that upheld a ban on diversity, equity, and inclusion programs, claiming it results in "discriminatory campus censorship."

item.title: Flexible, affordable, paying off: Online university degree programs see positive results, survey finds
item.description: 'The bottom line is online education can be an excellent choice when the program is affordable, high-quality, and aligned with a student’s goals.'

item.title: ‘Stunning’: Experts attribute USCD remedial math surge to DEI, poor teaching methods
item.description: A recent University of California San Diego faculty report shows a 30-fold spike in freshmen needing remedial math classes alongside a sharp decline in writing skills since 2020. Experts told The College Fix the crisis stems from a mix of pandemic disruptions, the abandonment of standardized testing, poor teaching methods, and a focus on equity […]

item.title: Biggest issue with UMich coach’s adultery is potential racism, race hustlers say
item.description: The University of Michigan fired its head football coach for adultery. Some worry about racist backlash.

item.title: Anti-Turning Point USA professor used class time to plot disruption: report
item.description: Critical race theory Professor Nicole Rousseau used class time to organize a protest of Turning Point USA at a Purdue campus.

item.title: ‘Power Rainbow’ by Harvard grad students teaches 3rd graders about systemic oppression
item.description: Two Harvard graduate students created the "Power Rainbow" tool to educate elementary children about systemic oppression. One is the recipient of a taxpayer-funded scholarship intended to support public service.
